title: Dojo training trial
description: One hand-authored dojo trial in data/trials/<id>.json (R7, YOK-105). The player gets exactly 3 attempts; landing the goal within them levels the trial's special. The goal is an ordered list of steps, each one thing the fight can observe (a Hit, Throw or block event, the dummy's state, the distance between the fighters), never a button or motion, so every trial is Kihon-completable (K2). Distances are gameplay units, frames are 60 Hz ticks.

special.description: Id of the special (kind 'special' in data/moves/) the trial levels (R7). At least one goal step must name it as its move.

prompt.description: What the dojo shows the player, in plain words (e.g. 'Hit the dummy at mid range, then anti-air its jump').

attempts.description: Fixed by R7: the special levels if the goal is landed within 3 attempts.

steps.description: Met in order within one attempt; events that match no step are ignored.

distance.description: Start distance between the fighters' centres, gameplay units (body width 120 .. max separation 960, SimConfig, AM7).

attempt_frames.description: Ticks one attempt lasts before it counts as failed.

dummy.description: What the dummy does. idle/crouch/guard/crouch_guard hold that stance; jump jumps straight up; attack plays `moves` in order (a string). The first jump or string starts on tick 1 of each attempt and the next every `every` ticks after, so `every` may not be longer than setup.attempt_frames (the validator and the loader check it).

moves.description: attack only: move ids from the dummy's kit, played as a string.

every.description: jump and attack: ticks from one start to the next (first start = tick 1 of the attempt); at most setup.attempt_frames.

step.description: One observation. hit = the player's strike or projectile connects unblocked (Match.Hit); a landed throw also raises Match.Hit but does not count as a hit or toward a combo. combo = `count` unblocked strike/projectile hits with the dummy held between them (its state is Hitstun, Knockdown or Thrown on every tick from one hit to the next; a dummy that recovered and jumped has left the combo). throw = the player's throw lands (Match.Throw, Land). block = the player blocks `count` of the dummy's hits. block and counter need a dummy with action 'attack'. Kata-only inputs (motion, precision) are not allowed (K1, K2).

move.description: hit: the strike or projectile that connects (not a throw); throw: the throw that lands; combo: a move that must be one of the combo's hits. Absent = any.

count.description: hit/block: how many (default 1); combo: hits in one combo (2 or more, required).

counter.description: hit only: must be a counterhit (C7), i.e. the dummy was in a move of its own when hit - any frame of it, startup and active included, not only recovery. Needs a dummy with action 'attack'.

dummy_state.description: hit/throw: the dummy's state on the sampled tick. A hit is sampled on the tick it connects. A throw is sampled on the tick its GRAB connects (the land comes break_window + 1 ticks later, with the dummy held on the ground), so 'throw it as it lands' is dummy_state landed on the grab. landed = not airborne on the sampled tick and airborne on one of the `landed_within` ticks before it. A throw cannot grab an airborne dummy (C4).

landed_within.description: Required with dummy_state 'landed', not allowed otherwise.

distance.description: hit/throw: distance between the fighters' centres on the sampled tick (hit: when it connects; throw: when the grab connects, before the land's slide), gameplay units.

motion.description: Kata only (K1): a trial must be Kihon-completable (R7, K2).

precision.description: Kata only (K1): the motion-input precision bonus cannot be asked for (R7, K2).

kata.description: Kata only (K1): a trial must be Kihon-completable (R7, K2).
